segments.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יְהוּדָה: בַּמֶּה דְּבָרִים אֲמוּרִים וְכוּ׳. אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל: הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוּדָה, וְלֹא עוֹד אֶלָּא כׇּל מָקוֹם שֶׁשָּׁנָה רַבִּי יְהוּדָה בְּעֵירוּבִין הֲלָכָה כְּמוֹתוֹ.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna: «Rabbi Yehuda said: In what» case «is this statement,» that one may establish an eiruv only with a person’s knowledge, «said?» This halakha applies to a joining of Shabbat boundaries, but not a joining of courtyards. «Rav Yehuda said» that «Shmuel said:» The «halakha is in accordance with» the opinion of «Rabbi Yehuda» in this regard, «and not only that, but any place where Rabbi Yehuda taught» a halakha «with regard to eiruvin,» the «halakha is in accordance with his» opinion.
